scope: Replacement research candidates for S&C SMU-20 25E, 65E, and 100E standard-speed fuse units in 14.4-kV SMD-20 outdoor distribution mountings; full manufacturer source geometry retained and canonical production data left unchanged.

records.name: S&C SMU-20 25E Standard Speed (14.4 kV)
standards: IEEE C37.41-2016 (edition derived from publication history; manufacturer TCC cites IEEE C37.41 without edition)
IEEE C37.46-2010 (final edition; manufacturer TCC cites IEEE C37.46 without edition)

interruptingRatings.standard: IEEE C37.46 (manufacturer-stated compliance; edition not stated)
interruptingRatings.basis: Complete SMD-20 mounting with the selected SMU-20 fuse unit; X/R basis is 15 in Specification Bulletin 242-31.

interruptingRatings.standard: IEEE C37.46 (manufacturer-stated compliance; edition not stated)
interruptingRatings.basis: Complete SMD-20 mounting with the selected SMU-20 fuse unit.

records.installationRequirement: Use the SMU-20 fuse unit with compatible SMD-20 mounting and end fittings. Match fuse-unit and mounting voltage ratings; apply the interrupting rating of the complete assembly.

curveEvidence.document: S&C TCC Number 153-2 PDF and manufacturer spreadsheet
curveEvidence.scalingBasis: No scaling. Full manufacturer spreadsheet coordinates are retained in source order, including duplicate-current and near-vertical geometry.
curveEvidence.extractionMethod: manufacturer spreadsheet; full source-point transcription with duplicate-current points preserved; no curve reduction

curveEvidence.document: S&C TCC Number 153-2-2 PDF and manufacturer spreadsheet
curveEvidence.scalingBasis: No scaling. Full manufacturer spreadsheet coordinates are retained in source order, including duplicate-current and near-vertical geometry.
curveEvidence.extractionMethod: manufacturer spreadsheet; full source-point transcription with duplicate-current points preserved; no curve reduction

curveEvidence.document: S&C TCC Numbers 153-2 and 153-2-2 with manufacturer spreadsheets
curveEvidence.date: 2019-06-03 PDFs; worksheet source dates retained in profile evidence
curveEvidence.scalingBasis: Minimum-melting profile is the lower operational boundary; total-clearing profile is the upper operational boundary. No scaling or reduced proxy curve is used.
curveEvidence.extractionMethod: manufacturer spreadsheets; full source-point transcription with duplicate-current points preserved; no curve reduction

curveValidation.notes: Six automated source-point checks per record: three minimum-melting lower-boundary checks and three total-clearing upper-boundary checks. Exact duplicate-current checks use the documented boundary policy. These are extraction/software checks, not independent engineering review.

profileSemantics.notes: Manufacturer statement for 10E through 400E ratings. The published minimum-test-point curve is retained directly; no symmetric time multiplier is inferred.
Manufacturer states all variations are minus and provides no percentage. The published maximum-test-point curve is retained directly; no symmetric tolerance is invented.

sourceDocuments.title: SMD Power Fuses - Outdoor Distribution
sourceDocuments.notes: Current manufacturer product page; identifies SMU-20 use, 14.4-kV SMD-20 ratings, 50/60-Hz interrupting ratings, and the applicable TCC documents.

sourceDocuments.title: Types SM-4, SM-5, SMD-20, and SMD-40 Power Fuses - Outdoor Distribution Specifications
sourceDocuments.notes: Direct SMD-20/SMU-20 ordering source for 14.4-kV standard-speed 25E, 65E, and 100E fuse-unit catalog numbers.

sourceDocuments.title: SMU-20 Fuse Units
sourceDocuments.notes: Current installation publication; states that SMU-20 ratings are listed in Specification Bulletin 242-31 and describes each fuse unit as a separately installed device.

sourceDocuments.title: S&C Manual PME Pad-Mounted Gear
sourceDocuments.notes: Cross-application source only. It lists SMU-20 units for PME gear and notes other compatible mountings; it is not the direct SMD-20 outdoor ordering bulletin and is intentionally excluded from catalog/applicability field provenance.

sourceDocuments.title: SMU Fuse Units - S&C Standard Speed Minimum Melting Time-Current Characteristic Curves
sourceDocuments.notes: Defines minimum-test-point plotting, plus 10% current variation for 10E through 400E ratings, 25 C/no-initial-load basis, and IEEE C37.41/C37.46 basis.

sourceDocuments.title: TCC Number 153-2 manufacturer spreadsheet
sourceDocuments.notes: Structured manufacturer points transcribed without curve reduction; source ranges are retained in profile settings.

sourceDocuments.title: SMU Fuse Units - S&C Standard Speed Total Clearing Time-Current Characteristic Curves
sourceDocuments.notes: Defines maximum-test-point plotting, minus-only variation, total-clearing semantics, 25 C/no-initial-load basis, and IEEE C37.41/C37.46 basis.

sourceDocuments.title: TCC Number 153-2-2 manufacturer spreadsheet
sourceDocuments.notes: Structured manufacturer points transcribed without curve reduction; worksheet source date retained separately from the 2019 PDF publication.

sourceDocuments.title: IEEE C37.41-2016 - IEEE Standard Design Tests for High-Voltage (>1000 V) Fuses and Accessories
sourceDocuments.notes: Edition in force when the manufacturer TCC publications dated 2019-06-03 were issued; the manufacturer publications cite C37.41 without an edition.

sourceDocuments.title: IEEE C37.46-2010 - IEEE Standard Specifications for High-Voltage (>1000 V) Expulsion and Current-Limiting Power Class Fuses and Fuse Disconnecting Switches
sourceDocuments.notes: Final C37.46 edition. IEEE identifies it as superseded by C37.42-2016; the manufacturer TCC publications nevertheless cite C37.46 without an edition.

review.notes: Candidate for qualified human review. Bulletin 242-31 is the direct SMD-20/SMU-20 ordering source; Bulletin 665-31 is retained only as a PME cross-application reference. Automated checks do not constitute independent engineering review or licensed-engineer approval.
